The evidence suggests that Tenalisib may interact with a protein kinase pathway that is involved in the regulation of CCRF-HSB-2. The scores from the paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, but the exact mechanism of action remains unclear. The presence of multiple targets in the pathway suggests that Tenalisib may influence multiple signaling pathways, potentially affecting the growth and survival of CCRF-HSB-2 cells. The integration of these findings supports the hypothesis that Tenalisib could have a role in modulating the activity of CCRF-HSB-2 through its interaction with protein kinase targets.
